# Combination of the seven methods and ablation (generated by code/ensemble_ablation.py)

Design and decision criteria fixed beforehand: 07_paper_draft/phase5_workflow.md, section 7. h = 3, L = 2, no liquidation. Δ = inventory / LGB-Q inventory − 1 in % (negative = less stock than LGB-Q), 95% bootstrap CI over series. Regret = excess over the best of the seven single methods, mean over reached fill targets 0.90–0.98.
